output: The initial lease term for the anchor tenancy at Northgate Business Park (tenant: Vantage Fulfillment Co., leasing 62% of net rentable area) is **10 years**, commencing April 1, 2025 and expiring March 31, 2035, with no early termination right for either party during that period. The tenant also holds two successive five-year renewal options at 95% of fair market rent.
